scenarios.title: A creature with swampwalk cannot be blocked while the defending player controls a Swamp
decisions: A attacks player B with Bog Wraith.
B declares Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Bog Wraith.

variants.label: defender_has_swamp
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Bog Wraith is illegal; Bog Wraith has no legal blockers.

variants.label: defender_has_forest
variants.delta: B controls a Forest instead of the Swamp.
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Bog Wraith is legal.

scenarios.title: Nonbasic landwalk makes a creature unblockable while the defending player controls a nonbasic land
decisions: A attacks player B with Dryad Sophisticate.
B declares Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Dryad Sophisticate.

variants.label: defender_has_nonbasic
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Dryad Sophisticate is illegal; Dryad Sophisticate has no legal blockers.

variants.label: defender_has_basic_only
variants.delta: B controls a Forest instead of Evolving Wilds.
variants.expected: Declaring Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Dryad Sophisticate is legal.

scenarios.title: Landwalk abilities do not cancel one another
decisions: A attacks player B with Bog Wraith.
B declares its own Bog Wraith (which also has swampwalk) as a blocker of A's Bog Wraith.

variants.label: defender_has_swamp
variants.expected: Declaring B's Bog Wraith as a blocker of A's Bog Wraith is illegal.

variants.label: defender_has_forest
variants.delta: B controls a Forest instead of the Swamp.
variants.expected: Declaring B's Bog Wraith as a blocker of A's Bog Wraith is legal.
